newsitem.title: USA: VISX shares tumble after Q2 forecast.
newsitem.headline: VISX shares tumble after Q2 forecast.

text.p: Shares in VISX Inc fell more than 20 percent on Thursday after the company warned its second quarter and fiscal 1997 results would fall short of its own expectations.

VISX, which makes excimer laser systems for use in eye surgery, said the shortfall in revenues and profits stemmed from weaker-than-expected U.S. demand. The company said it expected unit shipments of laser systems in the U.S. for the rest of 1997 would be in line with first quarter levels.
Shares in VISX fell 5-11/16 or 20.1 percent to 22-9/16 in early afternoon activity, top among net decliners on Nasdaq.
